decisions.statement: A body is parsed only after its signature holds.
A signature that does not have answers 403.
A body the shape refuses answers 400.
An event that is not a received message is ignored rather than turned away.
A message no seat accepts becomes a refusal notice to Alan.
A refusal notice that fails to land is named in the outcome.
A discard nobody could record is still answered as a discard.

definition: one inbound webhook carried from its signature to the seat that receives it
